6136.notes: Apaṇṇaka appears to be a gambling term, connected with kataggāha / kaliggāha. A set of dice divisible by four was kataggāha (see Brereton, Jamison RV 10.34) a 'perfect hand'. The fifth 'losing' (kali) die was all-powerful, since just one extra die meant you lose everything (Rig Veda 10.34.2, Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 5.4.4.6). Apaṇṇaka is therefore literally a 'set without a fifth', having the metaphorical sense 'without fail'.

examples.text: manāpaṃ vo, gahapatayo, satthāraṃ alabhantehi ayaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo samādāya vattitabbo. apaṇṇako hi, gahapatayo, dhammo samatto samādinno, so vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. katamo ca, gahapatayo, apaṇṇako dhammo?

puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

6185.commentary: (MNa) bālassa apadānānī'ti bāl'āpadānāni. (ANa) saddh'āpadānesū'ti saddhānaṃ puggalānaṃ apadānesu lakkhaṇesu.

examples.text: kacci pan'āyaṃ, subhūti, saddho bhikkhu sudattassa upāsakassa putto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito sandissati saddhā-apadānesū'ti?
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bāla-apadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

yato kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā sannidhikārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ. atha kaṇo'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, thuso'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, lūnam'pi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ, apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo aṭṭhaṃsu.

6187.meaning2: made clear or manifest in actions or by its results
6187.commentary: (ANa) apadānasobhanī paññā'ti yā paññā nāma apadānena sobhati, bālā ca paṇḍitā ca attano attano cariten'eva pākaṭā hontī'ti attho. bālena hi gatamaggo rukkha-gaccha-gāma-nigam'ādīni jhāpetvā gacchantassa ind'aggino gatamaggo viya hoti, jhāmaṭṭhānamattam'eva aṅgāra-masi-chārikā-samākulaṃ paññāyati. paṇḍitena gatamaggo kusobbh'ādayo pūretvā vividhasassasampadaṃ āvahamānena catudīpikameghena gatamaggo viya hoti. yathā tena gatamagge udakapūrāni c'eva vividhasassaphalāphalāni ca tāni tāni ṭhānāni paññāyanti, evaṃ paṇḍitena gatamagge sampattiyo'va paññāyanti no vipattiyo'ti. (ANt) apadīyanti dosā etena rakkhīyanti, lūyanti chijjanti vā'ti apadānaṃ, sattānaṃ sammā, micchā vā pavattappayogo. tena sobhatī'ti apadānasobhanī. ten'āha paññā nāmā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: kammalakkhaṇo, bhikkhave, bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito, apadānasobhanī paññā'ti. tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.

6189.meaning1: not routed; not rent; not torn apart; not smashed; not broken to pieces

examples.text: etadavocā'ti bhagavatā andhaveṇ'ūpamāya niggahito taṃ paccāharituṃ asakkonto yathā nāma dubbalasunakho migaṃ uṭṭhapetvā sāmikassa abhimukhaṃ katvā sayaṃ apasakkati, evam'evaṃ ācariyaṃ apadisanto evaṃ brāhmaṇo'ti-ādi-vacanaṃ avoca.

6195.meaning1: should be referred to; should be claimed as; to be pointed to

examples.text: ajja't'agge te, āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa na c'eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo, yam'pi c'aññe samaṇ'uddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sā'pi te n'atthi, cara'pi re, vinassā'ti.

6197.commentary: (DNa) mahāpadese'ti mahāokāse, mahāapadese vā, buddh'ādayo mahante mahante apadisitvā vuttāni mahākāraṇānī'ti attho.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, mahā-apadese desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
addhā, idaṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ, imassa ca bhikkhuno suggahitan'ti. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ mahā-apadesaṃ dhāreyyātha.
tassa evaṃ kicca-apadesa-bahulassa viharato anuppannā c'eva bhogā n'uppajjanti, uppannā ca bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
